component.name: Rinne
component.summary: Weekly anime planner that follows each series

description.p: Rinne turns your MyAnimeList or AniList list into a 7-day watch plan. When a show ends, its next season takes its place automatically, even if it isn't on your list yet, and Rinne explains why.

ul.li: A Sunday-to-Saturday plan built from the shows you're watching, with daily goals to complete
Follows every series: sequels replace finished seasons, and new seasons are announced
Drag shows between days, pause or pin a show, and catch up on airing shows
Optional two-way sync of your progress with MyAnimeList and AniList
Stats, a weekly recap and a calendar file for your calendar app
Show profiles with cast, voice actors and where to watch
Themes, a full-HD background slideshow and Discord Rich Presence

screenshot.caption: Up Next: what replaces each show, and why

ul.li: Changes made on MyAnimeList or AniList come back to Rinne too
Russian interface, and show titles in Russian from Shikimori
Undo for ticked episodes, and an offline notice

description.p: The biggest update yet: account sync, AniList, planning controls, stats and more.

ul.li: Connect MyAnimeList or AniList: your list comes in and stays in sync as you watch
Weekly goals: Sunday-to-Saturday weeks, celebrated day completions, completed and failed days in Stats
Episode titles and thumbnails, and where to watch each show
Pause, pin and pace shows, drag them between days, and catch up on airing shows
New seasons are announced, a calendar file, a Stats page and a weekly recap
In-app update check, a log file, and faster with large libraries
